node.title: Canonical check-in pure environment evidence-gate evaluator

notes: Yuri's standing uninterrupted-development authority permits this dependency-satisfied provider-free repository node.
The evaluator reads only normalized in-memory data at an explicit time and grants no external-fact, admission, secret, runtime or product authority.
DeepSeek native Harness was declined because no accepted runner fits the package unchanged; no new interoperability work or fallback was authorized.

decisions.summary: Accept one immutable capability-free reading over exact normalized manifest and evidence inputs at an explicit aware time.
Accept deterministic absent, invalid, stale, ambiguous, binding, evidence, break-glass and satisfied outcomes without ambient state.
Keep operational evidence authenticity, the default-off admission seam and every product or ordinary-practice action outside this node.
Honor Yuri's request by reviewing retained Harness evidence and freezing a minimum-testing real-work adoption plan next.

claim_scope: The evaluator consumes only exact normalized-result dataclasses and an explicit caller-supplied aware datetime.
It returns all eleven architecture reason codes in a deterministic fail-closed order.
It denies ambiguous selection, stale windows, cross-environment replay, wrong role and secret bindings, duplicate evidence, self-verification and non-inactive break glass.
A satisfied reading has no admission, route, command, database, secret-resolution or configuration capability.
No native Harness process, provider call, transport fallback or generic interoperability test occurred.
No external fact, product data, production action, Pages action or protected-ref movement occurred.
unresolved_gates: No operational manifest instance, external verifier selection or external operational fact exists.
The default-off admission input seam remains separately closed.
No accepted generic multi-file native Harness runner exists.
Ordinary-practice activation, product runtime, deployment and protected integration remain closed.

journey.strategic_role: Complete the provider-free reference-only environment evidence gate before any admission seam
journey.outcome: The normalizer, typed evidence inputs and pure evaluator now form a complete unmounted deterministic evidence-reading chain.

current_position.strategic_role: Turn accumulated native-Harness investigation into a pragmatic real-development operating plan
current_position.why_now: The current product tranche is complete and Yuri explicitly requested lower interoperability perfection, a review of all retained Harness work and minimum further generic testing.
current_position.outcome: One evidence-based adoption plan will preserve useful traceability and control, identify task shapes that can enter real work now, and limit adaptation to concrete first-use needs.
unlocks: Selection of genuine EMR4 worker packages based on accepted runner compatibility and task value.
A small task-driven adaptation budget instead of another open-ended qualification programme.
Matched efficacy readings that distinguish transport, model, orchestration and task failures.
does_not_solve: The review does not make native Harness the default worker or guarantee model quality.
It does not authorize provider calls, product edits or generic interoperability testing.
Any later product authority remains controlled by the active EMR4 tranche boundaries.
current_position.orientation_statement: Review retained evidence once, lower the perfection threshold explicitly, and plan the next native Harness use around valuable real work with only task-triggered adaptation.

next_operation.authority_source: Yuri explicitly requested this review and plan after the evaluator tranche and authorized continued work without ceremonial pauses.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The prospective incident-register reading exists before a closeout check validates its exact revision and population.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first typed-input clockwork dry run occurred before its prospective revision document existed and was rejected with tick_incident_revision_reading.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork check returned one closed reason and reported canonical_state_changed false.

correction.action: Create the exact prospective register revision before rerunning the check.
correction.prevention_control: Closeout preparation orders prospective register reading creation before the first tick check.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: carries one failed-closed prospective register ordering rejection.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: An active Baton acceptance label is already represented in the compact immutable lookup index.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The second dry run proposed a new unindexed descriptive label and the clockwork rejected it with tick_baton_compaction_unindexed.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork returned one closed label-index reason before publication.

correction.action: Reuse the indexed Current DeepSeek native Harness acceptance slot and retain its predecessor paths.
correction.prevention_control: New active acceptance labels are not coined during closeout unless their index admission is separately frozen.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: carries one corrected unindexed active-acceptance label.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The active acceptance row carries exactly one current incident-register revision path.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The third dry run retained both predecessor and prospective revision paths and was rejected with tick_incident_revision_path.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork rejected the active acceptance before any canonical write.

correction.action: Retain only the prospective current revision in the active row while leaving the predecessor indexed historically.
correction.prevention_control: Every active acceptance intent is checked for exactly one register revision path before the tick.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: carries one corrected active register-path singularity rejection.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A capability-absence assertion treats missing methods as the expected value rather than raising inside the test.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first focused test used getattr without a default and raised AttributeError while proving admit and execute methods were absent.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The focused suite failed at the test assertion while the satisfied reading fields were correct.

correction.action: Supply a None default to getattr and assert that no callable capability exists.
correction.prevention_control: Capability-absence tests use total attribute probes that cannot fail merely because the capability is absent.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected capability-absence test defect.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Boundary expectations follow the exact record timestamps and frozen reason precedence.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The manifest-issued-boundary test expected role_evidence_invalid although role evidence was current and the first rotation observation was future.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The evaluator returned rotation_evidence_invalid and direct timestamp readback confirmed that result.

correction.action: Correct the expected reason to rotation_evidence_invalid without changing evaluator semantics.
correction.prevention_control: Boundary cases derive expected stages from every normalized UTC timestamp before assertion.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected explicit-time stage expectation.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The commit-relative exact-path tripwire runs only after every authorized new path is visible in the Git index.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first surrounding run occurred while the new evaluator remained untracked, so Git omitted it from the working/index diff.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The tripwire reported the two accepted predecessor modules and not the still-untracked evaluator.

correction.action: Explicitly stage only the three authorized implementation paths before rerunning the tripwire.
correction.prevention_control: New authorized paths are staged explicitly before any Git-index-dependent conformance check.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected pre-stage tripwire sequencing error.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every added validation clause is syntactically connected before tests run.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: One hardening edit omitted or between the final secret-reference check and the next binding comparison.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Python compilation rejected the file immediately with a syntax error.

correction.action: Add the missing Boolean connector and rerun compilation, Ruff and focused tests.
correction.prevention_control: Compile immediately after multi-clause validation edits before entering the broader suite.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one compile-contained validation edit typo.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Caller-constructible normalized objects and explicit time inputs cannot escape the fail-closed public boundary.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Direct review found that a custom tzinfo could raise an arbitrary exception from utcoffset beyond the initial narrow exception list.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Sol traced the exact datetime boundary and added an exploding-timezone adversarial case before source acceptance.

correction.action: Contain hostile object exceptions at the public evaluator boundary and return manifest_invalid.
correction.prevention_control: Public pure evaluators receive an adversarial custom-object exception regression before acceptance.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected hostile timezone exception edge.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The active acceptance row stays within the compact Baton's fixed byte budget while the immutable index retains historical lookup.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first evaluator closeout check appended every predecessor and current path to a Baton already near its byte ceiling.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The clockwork rejected the prospective projection with tick_baton_compaction_budget before canonical publication.

correction.action: Retain only primary accepted artifacts in the active row and rely on the immutable index for full historical lookup.
correction.prevention_control: Estimate the replacement row against the existing Baton byte budget before the first tick check.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one failed-closed Baton compaction-budget correction.
